annotations.title: Check a DMR against its permit

description: Will EPA flag this period's Discharge Monitoring Report (DMR)? A US NPDES permit's Discharge Monitoring Report for one period, checked before it is filed: each value you send (outfall, parameter, statistic, value, unit) is set beside the permit's own limit for that period, from EPA's national limits file (ICIS-NPDES), with EPA's violation rule's verdict: flagged (EPA records a violation), ok, undecidable (a less-than result against a lower limit: EPA does not flag it, nor does it show compliance), no_data (a NODI code), not_graded (an alert or stayed limit), unreadable. A row we cannot place on one value due is refused by its code (outfall.not_in_permit, parameter.not_limited, statistic.not_limited, unit.not_on_form, period.not_due, row.ambiguous with the candidates), never put on the nearest limit. Every value due this period is in `limits` once with its limit_value_id (the cite into EPA's file); `not_sent` lists those you did not send, which EPA records as missing (D90) when filed blank. `headline` and `tally` are the forms as filed with exactly the values placed. `netdmr: true` adds the NetDMR "Import DMRs" file as text (not yet validated by NetDMR's own import check). The values reach our server to be checked and are not kept: only how many were sent, flagged and refused is counted.

netdmr.description: Also return the NetDMR "Import DMRs" file (CSV text) for the values placed.

period_end.description: The reporting period: its month (2026-09) or its last day (2026-09-30). A quarterly form is due on the period ending its quarter.

permit.description: The NPDES permit number, e.g. PA0228061.

values.description: The period's values, one a row, as the DMR prints them.

form.description: Optional: the DMR form (limit set) when two forms carry the parameter: its designator (A, Q) or name (001 Monthly).

limit_value_id.description: Optional: the limit's id from an earlier check_dmr or fill_dmr answer, in place of outfall, parameter, statistic and unit.

location.description: Optional: the monitoring location, EPA's code (1 effluent gross, G raw sewage influent, K percent removal) or its name.

nodi.description: A no-data code in place of a value: C no discharge, B below detection, 9 conditional monitoring ...

parameter.description: EPA's parameter code (get_permit's parameter_code: 00530, WEP6L) or its name (Solids, total suspended; TSS; ammonia).

qualifier.description: Optional: the value's qualifier, when the value is a bare number.

season.description: Optional: the limit's season number when seasonal limits overlap (1, 2).

statistic.description: EPA's statistical base code (MK, DD, WA, IA ...) or get_permit's words (monthly average, daily maximum, weekly average).

unit.description: The value's unit, which must be the form's: mg/L, ug/L, lb/d, MGD, SU, #/100mL ... It separates a concentration from a loading.

value.description: The number as filed: 12, 0.5, or a censored result as a string: "<0.10".

name: check_dmr
title: Check a DMR against its permit
